title: Leadership, Evangelism, & Discipleship (LEAD: Invited to Go and Teach), Student Leadership Guide 400
publisher: Wheaton Press (Engaging the Heart high school series)

sources.what: publisher high school course list (400 Level: Leadership, Evangelism, & Discipleship; 450 Level: Christ & Culture)
publisher product page (ISBN, description, five unit titles)
publisher preview-pack page and its course flyer image (cover title 'LEAD: Invited to Go and Teach', Imago Dei / Missio Dei description)
publisher high school scope-and-sequence image (Step Four, 'Going': 400 and 450 courses)

summary: The first-semester senior course in Wheaton Press's Engaging the Heart high school Bible sequence. Students study the Imago Dei and Missio Dei (God's purpose for the earth and their part in his mission), identify their own talents and learn to develop them into strengths, practice coaching others to find their calling, and finish with a team project and a personal plan for serving beyond the classroom.

toc.label: Unit One
toc.title: How have I been created to L.E.A.D.
toc.covers: Likely the course's doctrinal base: humans made in God's image (Imago Dei) and God's mission (Missio Dei), which the publisher says the course examines.

toc.label: Unit Two
toc.title: What is my identity, calling and commission?
toc.covers: The student's identity, personal calling, and commission to make disciples, framed within God's eternal plan.

toc.label: Unit Three
toc.title: How do I discover and invest my unique combination of talent?
toc.covers: Identifying one's talents and gifts and stewarding them into strengths for ministry and daily life.

toc.label: Unit Four
toc.title: How do I lead others?
toc.covers: Leading and equipping others, including coaching them to discover their own calling and use their talents.

toc.label: Unit Five
toc.title: How will I build a team and create a project that influences people beyond the walls of the classroom?
toc.covers: Building a team and carrying out an application project, ending with a personal plan to take part in God's mission.

notes: Identified from the publisher's high school page: the school's 'Bible IV: LEAD / Culture & Theology' catalog description matches Wheaton Press's 400 Level (LEAD) and 450 Level (Christ & Culture) course descriptions almost word for word, so semester 2 likely uses Christ & Culture, which is not in this work list. The school list gives no ISBN; the outline assumes the 2021 guide sold now. Only unit titles were found (the product page lists five units); no lesson-level contents or sample pages are published. No individual author is credited. The publisher says the 400 level is not recommended for students who have not taken its 100-250 level courses.
